Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) added 14.38 points, or 0.1 percent, to 26,064.02
U.S. stocks were higher after the close on Tuesday, as gains in the Consumer Services, Technology and Financials sectors led shares higher.
At the close in NYSE, the Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 0.06% to hit a new 6-months high, while the S&P 500 index climbed 0.03%, and the NASDAQ Composite index climbed 0.15%.
The best performers of the session on the Dow Jones Industrial Average were Walmart Inc (NYSE:WMT), which rose 1.62% or 1.53 points to trade at 96.07 at the close. Meanwhile, Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) added 0.81% or 1.76 points to end at 219.70 and Cisco Systems Inc (NASDAQ:CSCO) was up 0.77% or 0.36 points to 46.95 in late trade.
Overall, the bias in prices is: Upwards.
Note: this chart shows extraordinary price action to the upside.
By the way, prices are vulnerable to a correction towards 25,132.24.
The projected upper bound is: 26,534.70.
The projected lower bound is: 25,636.40.
